records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool at Harbor Tools
records.summary: An internal dispatch-desk tool for reconciling records and reducing repetitive reconciliation. Operators compared the overnight spreadsheet against the daily export; the tool handled mismatched references with understandable exceptions, visible late-file warnings, and visible empty rows. It was not route optimization or an externally sold product. Ada personally built the Python parser and SQL checks, gathered supervisor requirements, explained validation failures, and was responsible for the parser and checks. Supervisors made final dispatch decisions.

decisions.reason: The name, professional description, and each stated denial are supported by the source.
The role, dates, personal work on both tools, training, and handbook are supported; the summary preserves the team attribution for the outcome.

The source says operators preferred a visible warning, but does not establish that Dispatch Loom implemented late-file warnings. It also asks to distinguish operational use from an externally sold product without explicitly stating that the tool was not sold externally; the summary and denial claim,
The source identifies Roster Note as a personally built, separate SQL handover checklist and states that no user count or outcome is recorded.
The metric, six-run measurement, team attribution, Ada’s contribution, coworkers’ changed habits, and distinction from unmeasured delivery speed are supported.
The source supports the training details, personal handbook authorship, and the handbook’s five worked examples.
The source explicitly says Ada wrote the Python parser.
The source supports SQL checks for Dispatch Loom and a separate SQL handover checklist.
The source explicitly says PostgreSQL was used for the production database.
The source explicitly says Git was used for version control.
The source supports training dispatch coworkers and writing the plain-language handbook.
The degree, institution, and dates are supported by the source.
